offering_description.value: Operates a digital media platform that publishes content brands such as Sports Illustrated, TheStreet and Parade. It earns money from advertising, subscriptions and brand licensing, and serves online consumer audiences and advertisers. Content is produced by editorial teams and contributors and delivered through websites, apps and newsletters.

primary_products.value: digital media content; magazines; newsletters; licensed branded products

primary_services.value: digital advertising; content publishing platform services; brand licensing

customer_segment.value: B2C: online readers and subscribers of sports, finance and lifestyle content; B2B: advertisers, agencies and brand licensees

end_markets.value: digital media; advertising; sports; personal finance; lifestyle and entertainment

revenue_model.value: advertising: display and programmatic ads on owned websites and apps; subscription: paid digital and print subscriptions to publications; licensing or royalties: licensing of Sports Illustrated and other brands to partners

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: owns and licenses media brands, selling to licensees and advertisers; software / platform: runs shared publishing technology and audience platform for its sites; service provider: produces and distributes editorial content to readers and advertisers
value_chain_position.category: brand owner; software / platform; service provider

geography_served.value: global: Primarily US audience and advertisers, with online readers and licensing partners internationally

specialization.value: related lines: sports, finance and lifestyle media brands sharing a digital publishing platform

distribution_channels.value: online: owned websites, apps, newsletters and social platforms; direct sales: advertising sales team selling to brands and agencies; partners / resellers: licensing partners and ad networks

regulatory_exposure.value: low: Normal media rules, with data privacy and advertising rules such as FTC and CCPA

notes: Brand portfolio and licensing arrangements have changed in recent years; details may be outdated.
